name: Autonomous Development
description: Goal → Architect → Planner → Coder → Terminal → Browser → Tester → Security → Reviewer → Approval → Deploy. The full IDE pipeline as an auditable workflow. Deploy is ALWAYS a human approval.

config.description: start when a goal is given

config.prompt: Produce docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for the goal: components, data model, boundaries, failure modes.
Produce docs/PLAN.md: ordered tasks with acceptance criteria.
Implement the plan in src/ with tests in tests/. Keep imports resolvable.
Review the diff: correctness, style, risk. Flag anything you would not merge.

config.reason: deploy is critical — human decision required (Allow Once / Session / Inspect)
